title: Karyotype assignment — input
description: Pure-compute input to assignKaryotypes(). Must be portable: the same JSON runs in browser, Node, or any registry-agnostic harness.

id.description: Candidate id (e.g. INV_LG28_001). Optional but recommended.

K.description: Number of K-means bands locked for this candidate.

pc1.description: Per-sample PC1 score. Required to rank hom-like bands and place het-like bands.

per_sample_het.description: Per-sample heterozygosity rate ∈ [0,1]. When absent, the proxy-fallback path is taken if params.allow_pc_residual_proxy is true.

samples.description: Per-sample external IDs (e.g. CGA001). Optional; preserved in the output for downstream joins.

allow_pc_residual_proxy.description: When per_sample_het is missing, derive a proxy from PC residuals. Disabled by default — proxy is informative but not accurate.

multimodal_gap_z.description: Bimodal gap must exceed this many pooled σ.

multimodal_gap_min.description: Bimodal gap must also exceed this absolute het-units gap.

min_mode_samples.description: Each mode needs at least this many samples to be counted.

input_layer_ids.description: Provenance: registry layer ids the adapter resolved to build this input. Round-tripped to the output for lineage tracking. Compute itself ignores it.
